$comment: Derived from zipnative docs/assets/api.json (1.1.0). One row per export of the two entry points; docs/KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md section 8 maps every name to an MCP touchpoint (tool + input/output field). Enforced by tests/docs-consistency.test.ts: the name + subpath pairs equal the engine api.json when it is reachable, every name appears in backticks in KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md section 8, the reach counts add up to 88 capability / 9 type / 9 unexposed = 106, every whole export named in UNEXPOSED_EXPORTS (src/tools/describe-engine.ts) is an unexposed row (a member or field of an exposed export is called unexposed on its owner's row), and zipnativeVersion equals the installed engine VERSION. kind is derived from the export signature. reach grades the row: "capability" = the behaviour behind the export is exercisable through a tool, "type" = re-exported (or aliased) upstream for typing only, "unexposed" = deliberately not reachable from a tool argument (via names the reason; describe_engine.unexposed reports the same list at runtime); via names the touchpoint.

exports.name: AddEntryOptions
exports.via: create_zip entries[] and modify_zip add/replace: compression, date (read as UTC), comment, externalAttributes | unixMode (externalAttributesFromUnixMode), extraFields[] { id, dataBase64 }, zip64 (create_zip stream:true entries only; the APPNOTE 4.3.9.2 streaming layout) (toAddEntryOptions in src/entry-spec.ts)

exports.name: AddFromReaderOptions
exports.via: merge_zip.verify → addFromReader(reader, entry, { verify }) (default true: every entry CRC- and size-checked before it is copied; an entry with no registered codec is refused with ZIP_UNSUPPORTED_METHOD instead of being copied unchecked)

exports.name: AnalyzeDeterminismOptions
exports.via: inspect_zip canonicalDate → analyzeDeterminism(bytes, { date, limits, dosTimeMode: 'utc' }); canonicalize_zip summary.canonicalForm runs it with the pinned date

exports.name: ByteRangeSource
exports.via: access 'range' | 'auto' on inspect_zip, list_zip_entries, read_zip_entry: built from the sandbox file's own handle (zipPath) or from inline bytes; a remote / URL source is unexposed (no network path)

exports.name: ByteSource
exports.via: built internally by openArchiveSource (zipBase64 chunked / zipPath streamed through the one sandbox handle) for scan_zip_forward and by the sandbox file chunks for create_zip stream:true entries; an external ByteSource / ReadableStream is unexposed (JSON-RPC has no stream channel)

exports.name: CanonicalOptions
exports.via: canonicalize_zip date / keepComments / keepExternalAttributes and modify_zip canonical {...} (toCanonicalOptions in src/canonical.ts)

exports.name: CanonicalizeOptions
exports.via: canonicalize_zip: the canonical options + limits / strict and the diagnostic sink

exports.name: CodecCompressOptions
exports.via: unexposed: only handed to an injected codec's compressSync, and no codec can be injected (registerCodec is unexposed)

exports.name: CompactOptions
exports.via: modify_zip mode:'compact' with canonical {...} → saveCompact({ canonical })

exports.name: CreateZipOptions
exports.via: create_zip: order, defaultDate (ISO instant | 'now', read as UTC), compression, comment, limits, strict (+ the always-installed diagnostics sink with dosTimeMode 'utc', signal and onProgress)

exports.name: DEFAULT_ZIP_LIMITS
exports.via: describe_engine.defaultLimits; the baseline resolveCallLimits / effectiveLimits merge over (src/limits.ts); quoted in the limits input description

exports.name: DeflateTier
exports.via: the value set of create_zip summary.deflateTier and describe_engine engine.deflateTier { default, deterministic } ('injected' never occurs in this server)

exports.name: DeterminismConcern
exports.via: the value set of inspect_zip determinismReport.offenders[].concern and of the canonical-form check detail

exports.name: DeterminismOffender
exports.via: inspect_zip determinismReport.offenders[] { name, concern } (capped at 200)

exports.name: DeterminismReport
exports.via: inspect_zip determinism sub-checks (default verdict keeps the 1.0.0 formula), opt-in determinismReport and checks canonical-form / canonical-extras / canonical-version-made-by; canonicalize_zip summary.canonicalForm

exports.name: DosTimeMode
exports.via: fixed to 'utc' on every engine call by the diagnostic sink (a pinned date is the same DOS fields on every host); 'local' is not offered as an input

exports.name: EntrySkipReason
exports.via: verify_zip entries[].skipped and read_zip_entry verification.skipped ('encrypted' | 'stream-only-codec' | 'unsupported-method'); skippedCount

exports.name: EntryVerification
exports.via: read_zip_entry mode:'verify' → verification { ok, crcMatch, sizeMatch, localHeaderMatch, skipped? } (the engine's real localHeaderMatch and skip reason)

exports.name: ExtendedTimestamps
exports.via: list_zip_entries / read_zip_entry extendedTimestamps: true → the row field extendedTimestamps { mtime, atime, ctime, source: 'ut' | 'ntfs' | 'dos' }

exports.name: ExtractOptions
exports.via: extract_zip: rejectTraversal, rejectSymlinks, onDuplicate, filter (names/prefix/glob → filter(entry)), limits, strict

exports.name: ExtractedEntry
exports.via: extract_zip base64 mode rows (extractZip): path, entryName, index, sizeBytes, crc32, method, dataBase64

exports.name: ExtractedStreamEntry
exports.via: extract_zip dry-run plan (includeData:false) and file-mode rows (extractZipStream; stream() into the sandbox sink → filePath)

exports.name: FLAG_DATA_DESCRIPTOR
exports.via: decodeFlags() → flags.dataDescriptor on every EntryView row; viewFromHeader usesDataDescriptor (scan_zip_forward)

exports.name: FLAG_ENCRYPTED
exports.via: decodeFlags() → flags.encrypted on every EntryView row

exports.name: FLAG_STRONG_ENCRYPTION
exports.via: decodeFlags() → flags.strongEncryption on every EntryView row

exports.name: FLAG_UTF8
exports.via: decodeFlags() → flags.utf8; inspect_zip determinism.utf8Flags and check:'utf8-names'

exports.name: Inflator
exports.via: inflate_raw: push / finished / leftover / bytesConsumed / end → summary.bytesConsumed, leftover, finished

exports.name: IterateZipOptions
exports.via: scan_zip_forward: limits, strict + the diagnostics sink passed to iterateZipEntries

exports.name: METHOD_DEFLATE
exports.via: methodName() on EntryView rows, inspect_zip check:'deflate-only' / assert.method, inflate_raw method:'deflate', describe_engine.codecs

exports.name: METHOD_STORE
exports.via: methodName() on EntryView rows, inspect_zip check:'store-only' / assert.method, inflate_raw method:'store' (bounded pass-through), describe_engine.codecs

exports.name: OpenZipOptions
exports.via: inspect_zip.validate ('eager' default) and list_zip_entries.validate ('lazy' default); modify_zip and extract_zip open with validate 'eager'; limits / strict / onDiagnostic on every random-access tool; also the options of openZipRange (access 'range')

exports.name: RawEntryMeta
exports.via: unexposed: the metadata of ZipWriter.addRaw, where the caller vouches for the CRC and the sizes (an agent could forge an inconsistent archive); merge_zip exposes the checked addFromReader instead

exports.name: RawEntryReader
exports.via: the read side merge_zip hands to addFromReader (each opened source ZipReader satisfies it)

exports.name: ReadEntryOptions
exports.via: read_zip_entry.verifyCrc → readEntry(entry, { verifyCrc }) on the in-memory and the byte-range reader; { verifyCrc:false } on readEntryStream for a range

exports.name: StreamOptions
exports.via: create_zip.chunkSize → writer.stream({ chunkSize }) (file mode, 1 KiB … 16 MiB)

exports.name: StreamedZipEntry
exports.via: scan_zip_forward: header / data() (data:'verify'|'include') / skip() (data:'none', filtered-out and directory entries)

exports.name: StreamedZipHeader
exports.via: viewFromHeader() → scan_zip_forward.entries[] (isSymlink / usesZip64 / unixMode null; rawName → rawNameHex; descriptor headers carry zero sizes)

exports.name: UnixIds
exports.via: list_zip_entries / read_zip_entry unixIds: true → the row field unixIds { uid, gid } or null (Info-ZIP 0x7875)

exports.name: UnixModeOptions
exports.via: the { directory } option toAddEntryOptions passes with unixMode (create_zip entries, modify_zip add/replace)

exports.name: VERSION
exports.via: describe_engine.engine.version; serverInfo.instructions and __serverMetadata.engineVersion; the cache key namespace (CACHE_API_VERSION); pins docs/data/*.json in the docs-consistency test

exports.name: VerifiedEntry
exports.via: verify_zip.entries[] (name, ok, crcMatch, sizeMatch, localHeaderMatch, skipped?: 'encrypted' | 'stream-only-codec' | 'unsupported-method'), selected by entries:'all'|'failed'|'skipped'|'none'

exports.name: VerifyZipOptions
exports.via: verify_zip.limits → { limits }

exports.name: ZipBaseErrorCode
exports.via: the 7 base-code rows of ZIP_ERROR_CLASS (ZIP_API_MISUSE and ZIP_INTERNAL unreachable by design; ZIP_INPUT_TOO_LARGE needs > 2 GiB in one deflate call, above the inline caps)

exports.name: ZipCodec
exports.via: unexposed: a codec is executable code; JSON cannot carry one and zipnative ships no extra codec by policy (the built-in store/deflate codecs are visible through describe_engine.codecs)

exports.name: ZipCommonOptions
exports.via: strict and limits on every engine-touching tool (EngineOptionsShape); dosTimeMode pinned to 'utc', signal (MCP cancellation) and onProgress (notifications/progress with a progressToken) installed by the diagnostic sink on every engine call that takes ZipCommonOptions (verifyZip takes only limits, so verify_zip cannot be interrupted once it starts); onDiagnostic is unexposed — the server always installs its own sink so every archive tool's result carries diagnostics[]; nameDecoder is unexposed in 1.1.0 (a decoder is a function; a label-based, closed-enum input is a later candidate)

exports.name: ZipCompressionOptions
exports.via: compression { method: 'store'|'deflate', level 0–9, deterministic } at archive level (create_zip, modify_zip) and per entry

exports.name: ZipDataError
exports.via: mapZipError → _meta.error.data.errorClass 'data' with entryName and { expectedCrc, actualCrc } (8-hex)

exports.name: ZipDataErrorCode
exports.via: the 5 data-code rows of ZIP_ERROR_CLASS (ZIP_DECOMPRESSION_FAILED unreachable since zipnative 1.1.0 normalises every inflate tier to ZIP_DEFLATE_*)

exports.name: ZipDecompressor
exports.via: unexposed: part of the codec contract (ZipCodec.createDecompressor); no codec can be registered here — describe_engine codecs[].incremental reports it for the built-in store and deflate

exports.name: ZipDiagnostic
exports.via: createDiagnosticSink() → DiagnosticRow { code, severity, message, entryName? } in every result's diagnostics[] (dedup by code + entryName, cap 200)

exports.name: ZipDiagnosticCode
exports.via: ZIP_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES (12) → describe_engine.diagnosticCodes; diagnostics[].code; inspect_zip.prependedData / multipleEocd derived from two of them; ZIP_TIMESTAMP_CLAMPED is listed but unreachable (an out-of-range date is VALIDATION_ERROR first)

exports.name: ZipDiagnosticHandler
exports.via: the sink's onDiagnostic (src/diagnostics.ts)

exports.name: ZipEntry
exports.via: viewFromEntry() → EntryView rows (list_zip_entries, read_zip_entry.entry, extract_zip) incl. rawNameHex / commentHex / nameEncoding, opt-in extendedTimestamps / unixIds; inspect_zip statistics and determinism verdict; modify_zip planning; merge_zip filter and conflict planning

exports.name: ZipError
exports.via: mapZipError() instanceof root; err.code → _meta.error.code verbatim, err.name → _meta.error.data.engineError

exports.name: ZipErrorCode
exports.via: ZIP_ERROR_CLASS satisfies Record<ZipErrorCode, …> compile-time guard (the codes reach _meta.error.code and describe_engine.errorCodes)

exports.name: ZipExtraField
exports.via: read: extraFields[] { id, idHex, name, length, dataBase64? } on EntryView rows (list_zip_entries.includeExtraData adds the payload); write: extraFields[] { id, dataBase64 } on create_zip entries and modify_zip add/replace (id 0x0001 refused)

exports.name: ZipFormatError
exports.via: mapZipError → _meta.error.data.errorClass 'parse' ('input' for the two entry-name codes)

exports.name: ZipFormatErrorCode
exports.via: the 13 format-code rows of ZIP_ERROR_CLASS (all reachable through the hostile fixtures)

exports.name: ZipLimitError
exports.via: mapZipError → _meta.error.data.errorClass 'limit' with { limit, configured, observed }

exports.name: ZipLimitErrorCode
exports.via: the 2 limit-code rows of ZIP_ERROR_CLASS (ZIP_LIMIT_INVALID pre-empted by the Zod limits schema)

exports.name: ZipLimits
exports.via: the limits input (nine keys) on every engine-touching tool; describe_engine.defaultLimits; the operator ceilings bound four keys: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES (maxEntryUncompressedSize, maxEntryCompressedSize, maxTotalUncompressedSize) and ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_ENTRIES (maxEntries)

exports.name: ZipModifier
exports.via: modify_zip.operations[]: addEntry (add), replaceEntry (replace), removeEntry (remove), renameEntry (rename), setComment (setComment), save (mode:'append') / saveCompact (mode:'compact', with canonical {...} → saveCompact({ canonical })); .reader is unexposed (the input itself)

exports.name: ZipModifierOptions
exports.via: modify_zip: compression, defaultDate (new payloads), limits, strict

exports.name: ZipNameDecoder
exports.via: unexposed: a decoder is a function (ZipCommonOptions.nameDecoder); legacy code-page names stay CP437-decoded with rawNameHex kept for forensics

exports.name: ZipNameEncoding
exports.via: nameEncoding on every EntryView row ('utf-8' | 'cp437'; 'custom' never occurs, nameDecoder being unexposed)

exports.name: ZipProgress
exports.via: the engine snapshots progressReporter (src/call-context.ts) turns into notifications/progress when the request carries _meta.progressToken (strictly increasing, throttled at 200 ms)

exports.name: ZipProgressHandler
exports.via: the onProgress the diagnostic sink installs on every engine call when the request asked for progress

exports.name: ZipRangeReader
exports.via: access 'range' (or a zipPath above the 1 GiB in-memory cap under 'auto') on inspect_zip, list_zip_entries, read_zip_entry → results carry access: 'range'; limits.maxEntryCompressedSize bounds one fetched payload

exports.name: ZipReader
exports.via: entries() (every read tool), getEntry (read_zip_entry.name), readEntry / readEntryStream / readEntryRaw (read_zip_entry data / range / raw), verifyEntry (read_zip_entry mode:'verify'), entryCount / isZip64 / comment (inspect_zip, list_zip_entries; comment → commentHex); each merge_zip source is a ZipReader handed to addFromReader; .bytes only for modify_zip summary.noOp — unexposed as a field

exports.name: ZipSecurityError
exports.via: mapZipError → _meta.error.data.errorClass 'security' with entryName

exports.name: ZipSecurityErrorCode
exports.via: the 6 security-code rows of ZIP_ERROR_CLASS (all reachable)

exports.name: ZipUnsupportedError
exports.via: mapZipError → _meta.error.data.errorClass 'unsupported' with { feature }

exports.name: ZipUnsupportedErrorCode
exports.via: the 6 unsupported-code rows of ZIP_ERROR_CLASS (ZIP_UNSUPPORTED_ZIP64_STREAMING needs a streamed sourcePath > 4 GiB without zip64: true)

exports.name: ZipUnsupportedFeature
exports.via: _meta.error.data.feature ('zipcrypto' | 'strong-encryption' | 'aes' | 'multi-disk' | 'zip64-streaming' | 'cd-less-descriptor' | 'method:<n>')

exports.name: ZipVerificationReport
exports.via: the verify_zip result body: ok, error { code, message } | null, entryCount, entries, diagnostics (+ the wrapper's verifiedCount / failedCount / skippedCount / entriesTruncated)

exports.name: ZipWriter
exports.via: create_zip.entries[] → add / addDirectory (directory:true) / addStream (stream:true, zip64 opt-in) / toBytes (base64 mode) / stream({ chunkSize }) (file mode or when an entry is streamed); addFromReader (merge_zip, the checked transplant); addRaw is unexposed (the caller would vouch for the CRC and the sizes); the comment via CreateZipOptions.comment

exports.name: activeDeflateTier
exports.via: create_zip summary.deflateTier (activeDeflateTier(compression.deterministic === true)); describe_engine engine.deflateTier { default, deterministic }

exports.name: analyzeDeterminism
exports.via: inspect_zip determinism sub-checks, determinismReport, canonicalDate, checks canonical-form / canonical-extras / canonical-version-made-by (in-memory access only); canonicalize_zip summary.canonicalForm

exports.name: canonicalizeZip
exports.via: canonicalize_zip (the canonical deterministic form without recompression; idempotent)

exports.name: crc32
exports.via: compute_crc32 (dataBase64 | text | sourcePath streamed in 1 MiB chunks; seed chaining; expect → matches)

exports.name: createInflator
exports.via: inflate_raw method:'deflate' — the resumable bounded path (maxOutput mandatory) fed in 64 KiB chunks

exports.name: createZip
exports.via: create_zip (sequential writer)

exports.name: createZipModifier
exports.via: modify_zip over the opened reader

exports.name: externalAttributesFromUnixMode
exports.via: unixMode on create_zip entries and modify_zip add/replace (parseUnixMode → externalAttributesFromUnixMode(mode, { directory }))

exports.name: extractZip
exports.via: extract_zip base64 mode with includeData:true (in-memory extractor)

exports.name: extractZipStream
exports.via: extract_zip plan phase (includeData:false = dry run) and file mode (streamed into the sandbox sink)

exports.name: getCodec
exports.via: inflate_raw numeric method (decompressSync), methodName() on EntryView rows, describe_engine.codecs[] { sync, stream }

exports.name: getExtendedTimestamps
exports.via: list_zip_entries / read_zip_entry extendedTimestamps: true (opt-in row field)

exports.name: getUnixIds
exports.via: list_zip_entries / read_zip_entry unixIds: true (opt-in row field)

exports.name: getUnixMode
exports.via: unixMode (four octal digits or null) on every central-directory EntryView row (list_zip_entries, read_zip_entry.entry)

exports.name: initNodeZipCodecs
exports.via: unexposed: a startup concern — ensureEngineReady() (src/engine.ts) calls it once before serving so every sync codec path (the worker pool included) runs on the node-zlib tier; not a tool input

exports.name: isSymlinkEntry
exports.via: isSymlink on every EntryView row; inspect_zip.symlinkCount and check:'no-symlinks'

exports.name: iterateZipEntries
exports.via: scan_zip_forward (the forward reader over the ByteSource built by openArchiveSource)

exports.name: openZip
exports.via: inspect_zip, list_zip_entries, read_zip_entry (access memory, the default up to the 1 GiB in-memory cap), extract_zip (index pre-flight), modify_zip, merge_zip (each source), canonicalize_zip (re-open of the output)

exports.name: openZipRange
exports.via: inspect_zip, list_zip_entries, read_zip_entry with access 'range', or 'auto' on a zipPath above the 1 GiB in-memory cap — over the sandbox file's own handle (never a URL); a remote ByteRangeSource is unexposed

exports.name: rangeSourceFromBytes
exports.via: access 'range' on inline zipBase64 input (the same byte-range reader on bytes already in memory)

exports.name: registerCodec
exports.via: unexposed: a codec is executable code; JSON cannot carry one and zipnative ships no extra codec by policy — inflate_raw with a method beyond 0/8 answers ZIP_UNSUPPORTED_METHOD

exports.name: sanitizeEntryPath
exports.via: sanitize_entry_paths.results[].sanitized; sanitizedPath on every EntryView row; inspect_zip.unsafeNameCount / check:'safe-names'; extract_zip skipped list (rejectTraversal:false) and emptyDirectories

exports.name: setDeflateImpl
exports.via: unexposed: runtime code injection; the server owns tier selection and reports it (create_zip summary.deflateTier, describe_engine engine.deflateTier)

exports.name: setInflateImpl
exports.via: unexposed: runtime code injection; the reader paths run on the tier initNodeZipCodecs selected

exports.name: verifyZip
exports.via: verify_zip (the report returned verbatim; never isError for an archive problem)

exports.name: ByteSource
exports.via: the worker subpath re-exports the root declaration; the server imports ByteSource from the root entry only

exports.name: ParallelZipOptions
exports.via: create_zip.parallel { workers (≤ ZIPNATIVE_MCP_WORKERS), minWorkerJobSize, jobTimeout } + every CreateZipOptions field; workerUrl is unexposed (a path from a tool argument would point the worker at arbitrary code; the packaged worker resolves itself)

exports.name: ParallelZipWriter
exports.via: the create_zip writer under parallel (toBytes awaited; stream() in file mode); summary.parallel { requested, workers }

exports.name: StreamOptions
exports.via: the worker subpath re-exports the root declaration; the server imports StreamOptions from the root entry only (create_zip.chunkSize also applies under parallel)

exports.name: createParallelZip
exports.via: create_zip.parallel via dynamic import('zipnative/worker'); byte-identical to createZip per tier
